name: website-emulator
description: Mirror interactable DOM elements from a Playwright browser onto a local control panel

scripts.build: vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.json && cp src/browser/scan-in-page.js src/browser/on-screen-check.js src/browser/scan-visible-buttons.js dist/browser/
scripts.verify: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/verify.ts
